title: Resdine ERP
subtitle: Complete Restaurant Management System
description: A comprehensive, all-in-one Enterprise Resource Planning system specifically tailored for modern restaurants. It handles everything from real-time order tracking and kitchen display systems to inventory management, recipe configuration, and staff roles.
problemStatement: Restaurants often use disjointed software for POS, inventory, and back-office accounting, leading to data silos, inconsistencies, and high operational overhead.
solution: Developed a unified ERP platform integrating POS, robust inventory control with recipe-level ingredient tracking, and an advanced DevAdmin panel for system health and cache monitoring.
challenges: Migrating from legacy database-polling to a push-based WebSocket architecture
Ensuring accurate stock deduction based on complex recipe configurations
architecture: Event-driven architecture utilizing Laravel queues for background jobs and Reverb for real-time WebSocket communication.
databaseDesign: Relational schema prioritizing referential integrity for financial and stock data.
deployment: Deployed on Linux VPS using Nginx, configured with Laravel Horizon for queue management.

title: DFMS
subtitle: Digital File Management System
description: A robust document and file management solution designed for corporate clients to digitize, organize, and securely share their internal files and records.
problemStatement: The client struggled with decentralized physical records and an unstructured digital file sharing process, causing delays in audits and day-to-day operations.
solution: Built a secure, role-based document management platform with advanced search capabilities, version control, and comprehensive audit logs.
challenges: Implementing efficient and secure handling of large file uploads.
Designing an intuitive folder and permission inheritance system.

title: RecipeSys
subtitle: Food Manufacturing Recipe Manager
description: An internal company tool built to standardize and scale food manufacturing processes by meticulously managing ingredient ratios, batch sizing, and nutritional calculations.
problemStatement: Inconsistent batch outputs due to manual recipe scaling and lack of centralized ingredient data.
solution: Engineered a centralized system that dynamically recalculates ingredient quantities and nutritional info based on target batch sizes.
challenges: Handling complex unit conversions across various measurement systems.
